system.description: Both smart-fabric and legacy light vacsuit models are ideal for less harsh environments such as Mars, the Venusian clouds, or exoplanets with moderate but unbreathable atmospheres. Their rebreathers provide 8 hours of air. All models include a headlight, an ecto, and atmospheric sensors. They protect you from temperatures from -75 to 100 C. These vacuum suits also provide an Armor Value of 5/2 and instantly self-seal breaches unless more than 20 points of damage are inflicted at once.
